actual_scope: Follow-up to #7606/#7607/#7608 collecting the P104 results logged after #7606 (Nov 14): (1) lossless owned CLEAR content is free under owned_erasure and every CLEAR of an endpoint-exact word is lossless, with exact certificates for #7608's CLEAR #44 and for the clear-form-gap candidate (Q1 YES); (2) the r_max < k_min compiler hypothesis applies after strictification and the gate passes for #7546/#7605/#7608; (3) t = -1 toys: F2^3 decided by two independent proofs (Pin/DNL/Charge; Forwarding/Union/Duality), F2^4 survivors refuted by the Pocket Lemma; (4) 8 hubs realise the cut floor M = 72 on P104 (conjecture M >= n false in the frame model) but the V-funnel lemma forces a rank-96 public layer; (5) caller theory: Crossing and Floor Lemmas, B optimal among nested two-arm layouts, junk role = rho = 3, rho >= 3 no gain, beta = 4g+2, nesting proved at outermost/innermost stages only; (6) decoders: residual identity (C >= n odd denominators, >= 16 half level), h = 10 decoder 57, mod-3/fooling/lifted negatives, E8 odd-graph facts; (7) shape/framework: kappa bounded, Delta kappa = 0 under self-application, one outer level optimal; (8) radix 3 / spec challenge: endpoint wrappers exist in odd radix but Lemma Z keeps the per-port +1, decoder target H forces c >= v; (9) scoped negatives; plus explicit corrections of our earlier statements.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a constructive helper-basis or causal-split improvement. This package records theorems, scoped negative results and corrections on P104 (no kappa claim, no word) so that others can see which caller, decoder, t = -1, radix and framework routes are closed and why, and it discharges the CLEAR-content premise of #7608.
bottleneck_link: The P104 invoice's fixed costs (owned decoder mass, the per-port odd unit, the caller header) are what every proposed redesign has hit; this package proves where they come from (Crossing/Floor lemmas, residual identity, Lemma Z, target H) and which escapes remain open.
